stops.title: Out of Egypt
stops.text: The land the people left under Moses; the letter points back to this generation as a warning (3:16-19).

stops.title: The mountain that could be touched
stops.text: Where the law was given in fire, darkness, and a trumpet. The readers have come to something better.

stops.title: Salem, Zion, and outside the gate
stops.text: Melchizedek was king of Salem (often taken as Jerusalem); the readers have come to the heavenly Jerusalem; Jesus suffered outside the gate.

stops.title: Greetings from Italy
stops.text: "The Italians greet you": the only clue to where the author or readers were.

real.label: Map of the eastern Mediterranean, drawn from real coordinates. Numbered stops mark Egypt, Mount Sinai, Jerusalem, and Italy.
